bio: Semi Hassine and Patrizia Weidemann-Hassine run this restaurant in the old town, where exposed timber beams lend the space a charming rustic feel. The lovely terrace commands a view of the old half-timbered façades all around. On the menu: Westphalian cuisine with Mediterranean and subtle Eastern influences. Tip: the attractive changing seasonal set menu. Hot food is served from 4pm; on Saturdays from noon, all day....
